item.title: Mitigating global nitrogen loss in agriculture
item.content:encoded:
Nature Reviews Earth & Environment, Published online: 25 November 2026; doi:10.1038/s43017-026-00850-7

Inefficient use of nitrogen in agriculture causes widespread environmental pollution and threatens Earth-system stability. This Review examines drivers of nitrogen loss and assesses management practices, emerging technologies and socioeconomic barriers to sustainable nitrogen use in agriculture.

item.title: Artificial intelligence and machine learning for short-to-medium range weather prediction
item.content:encoded:
Nature Reviews Earth & Environment, Published online: 25 November 2026; doi:10.1038/s43017-026-00849-0

Short-to-medium range weather prediction is increasingly being transformed by artificial intelligence (AI). This Review discusses the development of AI weather prediction systems, their applications and integration with conventional models, key challenges, and strategies to improve forecast accuracy, reliability and trust.
